contexts.text: That men wanted to inquire into the mysteries of faith by sensuous and scientific things... AC 1072.
The inquiry about the evils within the Church... here begins.
Inquiry concerning this charity. Treated of.
Evil Spirits sought after them long, but in vain.
They sought after Heavens where the Lord is not acknowledged...
Nor do they inquire from the Word as to whether it is true; and if they did inquire they would not find it.
Inquiry as to why it is so. Signified.
The people come to me to inquire after God () = that they do not will and act from any other source than that the Word has said so.
Inquisition from good. Signified, Explained.
That they are to be inquired after from good. (Explained.)
Inquisition and dijudication by means of truth. Signified, Explained. AC 9166.
It is not angelic to seek after the evils with a man, unless the goods [are sought after] at the same time.
They who from longing had sought after truths (in the Word). HH 393:2.
The inquisition is extended through the whole body...
These fallacies the inquirer calls causes...
The inquisition concerning the soul.
The inquisition concerning the operation of the soul in the body.
They do not search after any sin in themselves.
They give aid without inquiring who and what he is...
Then an inquisitor meets them... TCR 622.
Inquire and learn what delight is... TCR 570.
They said that... I should be brought to the Inquisition.
A pit which is in the place of the Inquisition...
They sent to me a certain person who was an Inquisitor... SE 5633.
They said that they have the Inquisition... SE 5651:end.
Visitation is an inquisition as to the quality of a man; and the inquisition is made by Divine truth.
There is no freedom... (in Italy) on account of the Inquisition...
(The Dutch) are not informed, but they themselves inquire...
